      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Strategic_Alignment_Meeting" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Finance_Review" name="Perform detailed finance review of budget feasibility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Give_Feedback" name="Give feedback on plan from reviews">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" name="Adjustments required?" default="Flow_9">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Adjust_Plan" name="Adjust plan based on review feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Document_And_Approve_Adjustment" name="Document and approve adjustment by necessary stakeholders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Approve_Final_Budget" name="Approve final budget version">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Allocate_Budget" name="Allocate budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Distribute_Budget" name="Distribute budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Begin_Implementation" name="Begin implementing plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Implementation_Started" name="Department implementation started">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Budget_Planning_Starts" targetRef="Task_Outline_Objectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Outline_Objectives" targetRef="Task_Draft_Plan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Draft_Plan" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="Task_Strategic_Alignment_Meeting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Strategic_Alignment_Meeting" targetRef="Task_Finance_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Finance_Review" targetRef="Task_Give_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Give_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Task_Adjust_Plan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${adjustmentsRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Task_Approve_Final_Budget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_Adjust_Plan" targetRef="Task_Document_And_Approve_Adjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_Document_And_Approve_Adjustment" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_Approve_Final_Budget" targetRef="Task_Allocate_Budget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_Allocate_Budget" targetRef="Task_Distribute_Budget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_Distribute_Budget" targetRef="Task_Begin_Implementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_Begin_Implementation" targetRef="EndEvent_Implementation_Started"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
